text:
lia (ae): GreenWave Legal just pushed a hard requirement: notarized MSA before any POC data ingestion. They also changed payment terms to net45. Can we carve an exception?
ben (sales-eng): POC price approved. Main ops blocker is notarization + their ask for HSM attestation letter. We can supply a standard attestation for POC.
harper (legal): We should avoid full notarization precedent. Propose two options: (1) e-notary via DocuSign/eID; (2) scanned physical notarization up-front with originals mailed within 30 days. Limit to customer exec signature only.
harper (legal): Also revert their indemnity redline in 4.1 to our standard wording and keep our SLA cap. For subprocessors, change their "prior consent" to notice + 30d objection.
ryan (finance): If they insist on net45 for POC we need PO and AR approval before provisioning. If PO references the order form and uses net30 we can provision as soon as legal signs.
lia (ae): I'll send a one-paragraph addendum tying provisioning to either e-notary OR scanned notary + PO.
ben (sales-eng): I'll confirm with their counsel and offer the attestation letter.
sign-bot: :page_facing_up: Envelope ab12 created for GreenWave (MSA_v3_redline.pdf, OrderForm_POC.pdf). Status: awaiting customer signature.
harper (legal): Draft clause for notarization (suggested): "Customer may execute by (a) electronically notarized signature or (b) physical notarization; if (b), Customer will provide scanned certificate at execution and deliver original within thirty (30) days. Notary applies to Customer exec only"
lia (ae): Customer replies: physical notary preferred; they'll try to send scanned copy first and PO this week.
ben (sales-eng): Moving to DM to confirm signer and billing contact.
harper (legal): Updated MSA_redline_tracker and tagged @ryan for billing terms.
ryan (finance): Watching for PO. If net30 on PO, fast-track provisioning.
lia (ae): Closing — will update when PO or signed docs received.
